native_explainer.title: Як українська передає значення англійського «for»
native_explainer.body: В англійській слово «for» охоплює кілька різних відношень, а в українській одного універсального відповідника немає. Для особи, призначення або мети часто вживаємо «для» + родовий відмінок. Причину можна виразити «через» + знахідний, тривалість — «протягом» + родовий або часовою групою, напрямок і кінцеву межу — «до» + родовий чи конструкцією «у/в» + знахідний. Обмін, ціну, заміну або підтримку часто передають конструкції з «за». Тому перекладаємо не саме слово «for», а його функцію в реченні.

rules.summary_en: Для + genitive commonly marks intended purpose, intended user, beneficiary, or intended recipient.
tips_en: Ask who or what something is intended for.
Treat для as one common construction, not as a universal replacement for English for.

rules.summary_en: Через + accusative can mark a cause or reason, especially an adverse or explanatory cause.
tips_en: If English for means because of, check a causal construction instead of для.
The noun after через is accusative in this construction.

rules.summary_en: Протягом + genitive explicitly marks the duration or span during which something continues.
tips_en: Use a duration construction when for answers how long.
Do not confuse elapsed duration with a deadline or target time.

rules.summary_en: До + genitive marks reaching a spatial endpoint or a temporal limit; destination wording may also use у/в + accusative depending the motion construction.
tips_en: For a destination, learn the motion verb together with the required destination construction.
When до marks time, think endpoint or deadline rather than duration.

rules.summary_en: За + accusative occurs in common price, exchange, substitution, payment, and support/favor constructions.
tips_en: If for means in exchange for or in support of, за is an important pattern to check.
Learn the whole construction because за has many unrelated meanings.

languages.notes: Lesson-focused candidate synthesis. Ukrainian motion/destination and temporal constructions are construction-sensitive; native review is required before stronger trust promotion.

native_explainer.title: Как русский язык передаёт значения английского «for»
native_explainer.body: В английском for объединяет несколько отношений, которые русский язык обычно разводит. Для адресата, назначения и цели часто используется «для» + родительный. Причину обычно выражают «из-за», «по причине» и другими причинными конструкциями; длительность — «в течение» + родительный или формой времени. Направление зависит от цели движения: «в/на» + винительный, «к» + дательный, иногда «до» + родительный. Цена, обмен, замена и поддержка часто используют «за» + винительный. Срок можно задать через «до». Поэтому сначала определяем смысловую связь, а не ищем один перевод for.

rules.summary_en: Для + genitive commonly marks intended recipient, intended use, purpose, or beneficiary.
tips_en: Ask who or what the thing/action is intended for.
Do not use для automatically when English for expresses cause, duration, exchange, or destination.

rules.summary_en: Из-за + genitive marks cause or reason, commonly with an unwanted, problematic, or explanatory result.
tips_en: If for means because of, Russian normally needs a causal construction rather than для.
The governed noun is genitive.

rules.summary_en: В течение + genitive explicitly marks a span of time during which something happens or remains true.
tips_en: Use this family when for answers how long or during what span.
A duration is different from a deadline such as до пятницы.

forms.display: в/на + винительный; к + дательный; до + родительный

rules.summary_en: Russian destination and endpoint meanings are distributed across motion constructions such as в/на + accusative, к + dative, and до + genitive; до also marks a temporal endpoint/deadline.
tips_en: Learn destination marking with the motion verb and type of destination.
When до is temporal, read it as an endpoint, not as elapsed duration.

rules.summary_en: За + accusative is central in many price, exchange, payment, substitution, voting, and support/favor expressions.
tips_en: If for means in exchange for or in favor of, check за.
Because за has many other meanings, learn the complete phrase rather than translating the preposition alone.

native_explainer.title: Jak polski wyraża znaczenia angielskiego „for”
native_explainer.body: Angielskie for nie ma jednego polskiego odpowiednika. «Dla» + dopełniacz często wskazuje beneficjenta, odbiorcę albo przeznaczenie; cel może też wymagać «na» + biernik albo zdania z «żeby/aby». Przy cenie, wymianie, zastępstwie i poparciu często pojawia się «za» + biernik. Przyczyna to m.in. «z powodu» + dopełniacz lub w części konstrukcji «przez» + biernik. Czas trwania może wyrażać «przez» + biernik, a termin końcowy «do» + dopełniacz. Kierunek zależy od miejsca, np. «do Warszawy». Najpierw ustalamy relację znaczeniową, dopiero potem wybieramy formę.

rules.summary_en: Dla + genitive commonly marks a beneficiary, intended audience/recipient, or intended purpose/use.
tips_en: Ask for whom or for what use something is intended.
Polish purpose is broader than dla; verbal goals often use other constructions.

rules.summary_en: Purpose can be expressed by na + accusative in many noun-goal constructions or by żeby/aby clauses for an explicit intended result.
tips_en: Do not force every English purpose-for into dla.
Choose the construction according to whether the goal is a noun phrase or a clause.

rules.summary_en: Z powodu + genitive is an explicit cause/reason construction; przez + accusative can also mark cause in many contexts.
tips_en: If English for means because of, switch to a cause construction.
Przez can also be causal, so use the full phrase and context rather than a one-word mapping.

rules.summary_en: Przez + accusative commonly marks the duration of an event or state.
tips_en: When for answers how long, przez is a strong pattern to check.
Keep duration separate from the deadline/endpoint meaning expressed with do.

rules.summary_en: Do + genitive commonly marks destination toward many places and a temporal endpoint/deadline.
tips_en: Destination marking depends on the kind of place, so learn the noun with its construction.
Temporal do means up to/by an endpoint, not for a span of time.

rules.summary_en: Za + accusative occurs in common price, payment, exchange, substitution, voting, and support/favor constructions.
tips_en: If for means in exchange for, for a price, or in favor of, check za.
Learn the entire phrase because za also has unrelated spatial and temporal uses.

languages.notes: WSJP PAN is used as the primary lexical authority; construction-level synthesis remains candidate pending Polish-native review.

native_explainer.title: Како македонскиот ги изразува значењата на англиското „for“
native_explainer.body: Англиското «for» покрива повеќе односи што македонскиот ги дели меѓу различни форми. «За» често означува намена, крајна цел на движење или нешто наменето за некого/нешто, а «за да» јасно воведува целна реченица. «Поради» најчесто означува причина, додека «заради» може да означува и цел и причина, зависно од контекстот. «До» означува просторна или временска граница, а «во текот на» временско траење. При цена, замена или противвредност повторно може да има конструкции со «за». Значи, не го преведуваме «for» механички; прво го утврдуваме односот во реченицата.

rules.summary_en: За commonly covers intended purpose/use, intended recipient/beneficiary, and destination/goal relationships in Macedonian.
tips_en: За is broad, but it is not a universal substitute for every English for.
Ask whether the phrase points toward an intended person, use, or endpoint.

rules.summary_en: За also occurs in common price, exchange, substitution, and countervalue constructions.
tips_en: When for means in exchange for or at a price, a construction with за is common.
Use the whole construction because за also marks several other relations.

rules.summary_en: За да introduces an explicit purpose clause, linking an action to the intended result.
tips_en: Use this when the purpose itself is expressed as a clause.
The official Macedonian dictionary explicitly describes за да as signaling the goal of the action.

rules.summary_en: Поради and заради mark cause; the official dictionary also records purpose/intention uses, especially for заради and in some поради contexts.
tips_en: Do not force a rigid one-form-per-meaning split here: the official dictionary records overlap.
Use context to distinguish an actual cause from an intended aim.

rules.summary_en: До marks a spatial limit/endpoint and a temporal limit, covering destination-endpoint and deadline relationships.
tips_en: Think of до as reaching a boundary.
A temporal boundary is a deadline/endpoint, not elapsed duration.

rules.summary_en: Во текот на marks the span during which something happens or continues.
tips_en: Use a duration construction when for answers how long/during what period.
Keep duration separate from the temporal endpoint expressed with до.
